description: Erbil Smart Home Energy Dataset – 39 houses [ESHED-39 (2020–2025) ] is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Truska Jaf, Ibrahim Ismael Hamarash (Salahaddin University-Erbil). This dataset contains real-world measurements of residential energy consumption collected from 39 houses in Erbil. The dataset spans from 14 May 2020 to 17 June 2025 and integrates daily energy usage, occupancy information, building characteristics, and detailed weather variables. Energy consumption (kWh) was recorded using smart meters installed by the Ministry of Electricity. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
